name: page_forward
description: A soft airy swish moving forward
use: Pushing a new screen, next step in a wizard, next onboarding page
prompt: A soft airy swish of a light breeze passing quickly from left to right, short, smooth, natural, no music

name: page_back
description: A soft airy swish moving back
use: Back navigation, previous step, dismissing a pushed screen
prompt: A soft airy swish of a light breeze passing quickly from right to left, slightly lower and softer, short, natural, no music

name: tab_switch
description: A pebble rolling one notch on stone
use: Switching bottom tabs or segmented controls
prompt: One single soft click of a small pebble set onto a flat stone, then complete silence, one hit only, very close, dry, no music

name: modal_open
prompt: A gentle short breeze swelling softly upward then stopping, airy and light, natural, no music

name: modal_close
prompt: A short soft breath of breeze closing in and stopping, clear and present, close, airy, natural, no music

name: sheet_up
prompt: A soft cotton cloth sliding quickly upward over a wooden table, short smooth fabric swish, close up, no music

name: sheet_down
prompt: A soft cotton cloth sliding down and settling on a wooden table, short gentle fabric swish, close up, no music

name: expand
use: Expanding accordions, show more, opening a details panel
prompt: A large fresh leaf unfurling and opening, short soft papery rustle, close up, natural, no music

name: collapse
use: Collapsing accordions, show less, closing a details panel
prompt: A large leaf folding closed quickly, short soft rustle that ends tight, close up, natural, no music

name: menu_open
description: A small bird's wings lifting off
use: Opening menus, popovers, the side drawer
prompt: A small bird's wings fluttering briefly as it lifts off a branch, quick soft feather flaps, no chirp, close up, no music
